outcomes.intended_user_result: An authorized caller can inspect a bounded exact revision/source page and know whether coverage is exact, partial, summary-only, or unavailable.
outcomes.current_baseline: mind_inspect accepts an exact record and optional revision but returns full available fields without page/range continuation or explicit coverage semantics.
outcomes.acceptance: Revision-bound bounded inspection returns honest coverage, hard byte/character limits, source identity, and an opaque continuation bound to revision and authorization; inaccessible and unavailable content does not disclose hidden identity.

excluded_scope: No Origami summary generation in R9.
No automatic conversation compaction, proxy, acp-kernel, billion-context, model, vector, graph, MCP, or external backend.
No new top-level tool; mind_trace, mind_explore, and mind_manage remain unavailable.
No retention, confidence, validity, adoption, fading, deletion, or learning-policy change.
No remote publication or live installation without new explicit authorization for R9.
next_authorized_goal_ref: Origami only after R9 exact inspection adoption decision
